name: ShadowNeuS
aliases: Neural SDF Reconstruction by Shadow Ray Supervision
definition: A method that reconstructs a neural Signed Distance Field (SDF) of a scene from single-view images under multiple lighting conditions by supervising shadow rays (rays between the light source and the scene) rather than just camera rays.
summary: ShadowNeuS reconstructs neural signed distance fields from single-view images by supervising shadow rays to capture geometry cues that standard NeRF misses.
